sloka: नास्ति रामस्य सदृशो विक्रमे भुवि कश्चन ।विराधो निहतो येन कबन्धश्चान्तकोपमः ॥६-३०-२९॥।।
transliteration: nāsti rāmasya sadṛśo vikrame bhuvi kaścana ।virādho nihato yena kabandhaścāntakopamaḥ ॥6-30-29॥।।

translations.english: "Viradha and even Kabhanda who was like the Lord of death were killed by Rama. Perhaps there is none equal to Rama in valour in this world."
